Fun Facts

  • This Station features a total of ten Connecting Passageways (with five passageways for each floor) that provides access between the four platforms and the concourse. This ensures that at least one accessible passageway is available for each platform, as well as independent operations of and . The design integrates that of , and Stations, and the function of each connecting passageway is as follows:
  • North Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor, Stair Access to Concourse and the other Platform Level.
  • Mid-North Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor, Elevator Access to Concourse and the other Platform Level.
  • Middle Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor.
  • Mid-South Passageways: Connection between Platforms of different floors in the form of a ramp. There are two such passageways, one between Platforms 1-4, and the other between Platforms 2-3.
  • South Passageway: Connection between Platforms of the same floor, Stair Access to Concourse and the other Platform Level.
  • Colored wool representing and are used at the Platforms and Concourse of this Station to indicate that the area is located at a closer vicinity to that respective route or is used for that route. A similar design was also used at Markost Station.
  • This Station was not a part of the original 2024 Development Plans, but was added due to Intus Aquilo Development.
